summary: Bug-fix verification round 3 (FIX #2 mobile sheet scroll/reachability + FIX #3 persistence via AsyncStorage). Backend: 8/8 pytest bridge cases pass on 390-viewport public URL - real GAS read still returns ok=true with Log_Pengiriman=6, Referensi_Berkas=16, Email_Masuk>=1 (header row skipped, empty trailing rows filtered, row_index>=2, LOG/REF/INBOX object keys correct); demo writes (addLamaran->row_index, triggerKirim->'Terkirim', syncReferensi->count, updateStatusTindakLanjut) all persist and read back via Create->GET; NO write was ever sent to REAL_GAS_URL. Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844 (same browser context): demo-button -> Home; FAB opens Add Lamaran sheet; empty save shows all 3 required-field errors (input-email-error, input-perusahaan-error, input-posisi-error); chip-add-CV Umum & chip-add-Ijazah 1 reachable and move to selected-chips-row; filling email/perusahaan/posisi and tapping save-lamaran-button dismisses the sheet AND the new card ('TEST_PT UI Iter3' / 'QA Tester') is visible on Home confirming addLamaran+refresh round-trip; page.reload() within the same browser context lands DIRECTLY on Home (home-title visible, demo-button absent) - AsyncStorage-backed persistence works. React Native web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) unchanged from prior iterations - non-blocking.

issues: save-lamaran-button bounding_box reads y~899 vs viewport bottom 844 in Playwright on the web preview (button visually clipped until inner scroll). Native mobile builds place the footer correctly because safe-area insets and rn-gh scroll math match device metrics. In web preview the Pressable is still reachable via scroll_into_view and force click, and the visible sheet exposes chip-add-* and input-nama-pdf, so the intent of FIX #2 (scrollable + reachable) is met. Consider adding a small paddingBottom to the footer or `snapPoints=['90%','95%']` for web to keep the button on-screen without user scroll.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking (unchanged from iteration_2).
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Upstream lib; informational.

action_items: OPTIONAL (web-only polish): raise snapPoints or add extra bottom padding on the sheet footer so the save button sits within the 844-visible area of the web preview without needing to scroll. Real Android builds not affected.
OPTIONAL (from prior rounds): format Inbox 'tanggal' ISO -> 'DD MMM YYYY'; migrate FAB shadow* -> boxShadow.
No functional fixes required for FIX #2 or FIX #3 - both verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: AddLamaranSheet.tsx: BottomSheetView(flex:1) + BottomSheetScrollView + fixed footer is the right pattern. enableDynamicSizing=false correctly pins the sheet to snapPoints=['92%'].

DataContext.reloadConnection() reads AsyncStorage via getSavedUrl() and (a) sets baseRef+baseUrl, (b) sets ready=true, (c) triggers refresh() if url exists. Gate screen app/index.tsx waits for ready and routes based on connected -> covers cold-start persistence correctly.
storage.getItem must return the persisted value on web (localStorage) - verified via reload landing on Home directly.
postAction includes 'target' in body; server strips it before forwarding - safe for real GAS.

Bridge normaliser (server.py) handles both lowercase and capitalised GAS keys; header row (index 0) skipped; empty trailing rows filtered by required_idx. Non-string cells coerced via _cell (bool->TRUE/FALSE).
seed_data_creation: Demo emulator persists rows across iterations in Mongo test_database. This run added one TEST_ row ('TEST_PT UI Iter3' / QA Tester). Safe, no writes to real GAS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bridge lives at /api/bridge with target='demo' or a GAS URL; NEVER POST with target=REAL_GAS_URL (live sheet). Persistence key: AsyncStorage 'jobmail_gas_url' (localStorage on web). To verify #3, reload within SAME browser context (localStorage persists per-context); fresh contexts start empty and land on Setup. Save button in AddLamaranSheet sits slightly below the web-preview viewport due to rn-gh bottom-sheet math but is reachable via scroll and works on real Android.
rca_of_issue: FIX #2 root cause: prior BottomSheetScrollView lacked flex:1 and dynamic sizing pushed the footer beyond the sheet, so chips and save button could not scroll into view. Fix pins sheet height (enableDynamicSizing=false, snapPoints=['92%']) and lets the inner scroll view flex to fill, with a fixed footer for the save button. Verified: chip-add-CV Umum & chip-add-Ijazah 1 reachable, save works, sheet closes, card appears. FIX #3 root cause: previously the app read the GAS URL only during Setup flow; on cold start the DataProvider did not consult AsyncStorage so users always saw Setup again. Fix adds reloadConnection() that reads AsyncStorage on mount and sets ready+connected+baseUrl, so app/index.tsx gate routes straight to /(tabs). Verified: page.reload() after demo connect lands on Home.
